# pbs_dns (Data Source)

Reads the DNS settings of a Proxmox Backup Server node — its search domain and up to three nameservers —, as PBS reads them from `/etc/resolv.conf`; `pbs_dns` manages them. The file is read as it is: where systemd-resolved or a container runtime provides it, the nameservers are theirs, such as systemd-resolved's `127.0.0.53`. PBS reads only the first domain of the last `search` or `domain` line and the first three nameservers, without the zone of a link-local one, such as `%eth0`. Reading works where Docker or Kubernetes mounts `/etc/resolv.conf`, where `pbs_dns` cannot change it.

Needs `Sys.Audit on /system/network/dns`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_dns" "this" {}

# The node's nameservers, in order, such as ["192.0.2.53", "192.0.2.54"].
output "pbs_nameservers" {
  value = compact([data.pbs_dns.this.dns1, data.pbs_dns.this.dns2, data.pbs_dns.this.dns3])
}

# Warn when the node depends on a single nameserver: without it, PBS resolves
# no name — not its remotes, S3 endpoints, ACME CA or APT mirrors.
check "pbs_has_a_second_nameserver" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_dns.this.dns2 != null
    error_message = "The PBS node has one nameserver only, ${coalesce(data.pbs_dns.this.dns1, "none")}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `dns1` (String) IP address of the node's first nameserver, from the first `nameserver` line; null when there is none.
- `dns2` (String) IP address of the node's second nameserver, from the second `nameserver` line; null when there are fewer.
- `dns3` (String) IP address of the node's third nameserver, from the third `nameserver` line; null when there are fewer.
- `search` (String) Search domain of the node, such as `example.org`: the first domain of the last `search` or `domain` line of `/etc/resolv.conf`; null when there is none.
